import re

lines = csv_content.strip().split('\n')
header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]
print(f"Headers: {header}")

won_deals = []
won_total = 0

for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = [f.strip() for f in line.split(',')]
    row = dict(zip(header, fields))
    if row.get('status', '').lower() == 'won':
        amount = int(row['amount'])
        won_total += amount
        won_deals.append(row)

print(f"\nWon deals ({len(won_deals)} total):")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<8} {'Rep':<20} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")
print("-" * 90)
for d in won_deals:
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<8} {d['rep_name']:<20} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<25} {int(d['amount']):>10,} {d['close_date']:<12}")
print("-" * 90)
print(f"{'TOTAL':>63} {won_total:>10,}")
print(f"\nTotal new contract value for Meridian Analytics (won deals): ${won_total:,}")
